WealthBridge Asset Management Limited has secured an upgrade of its Investment Manager Rating from BBB+(IM) to A-(IM), with a stable outlook, from DataPro Limited, while obtaining three internationally recognised ISO certifications. The rating upgrade, announced in November 2026, reflects the company’s financial position, operating performance and business profile, with increased revenue, good liquidity, a significant asset base and an experienced management team identified as key factors, according to a statement from the firm on Tuesday. The assessment also recognised the expansion of its financial and investment management operations. In a separate assessment, Agusto & Co. affirmed the company’s Investment Manager Rating at BBB(IM), citing its experienced leadership, decision-making capabilities, support from the wider WealthBridge Financial Services Group and increasing adoption of technology. However, the assessment identified organisational capacity and the experience of certain specialist teams as areas requiring further strengthening. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources The three ISO certifications secured by the company cover its Information Security Management System (ISO/IEC 27001:2022), Business Continuity Management System (ISO 22301:2019) and IT Service Management System (ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018). Issued on 21 October 2026 and valid until 20 October 2029, subject to applicable certification requirements, the certifications cover the company’s information security, business continuity and technology service operations. The ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification recognises the company’s framework for managing information security across its business processes, information assets, personnel, technology infrastructure and third-party services. Similarly, the ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018 certification covers its IT Service Management System, including IT infrastructure, applications, service desk operations, incident and problem management, change management, service continuity and technical support. Commenting on the developments, the Group Chief Executive Officer of WealthBridge Financial Services Holdings Limited, Ahmed Lawal, said the rating upgrade reflected progress in strengthening the company’s financial position and operational capacity. He said, “The upgrade by DataPro is an encouraging recognition of the progress WealthBridge Asset Management has made in strengthening its financial position, operational capacity and institutional capabilities. We also value the independent assessment by Agusto & Co., including the areas identified for further development, as we remain committed to continuous improvement. “The attainment of three ISO certifications further demonstrates our commitment to building an institution anchored on strong governance, information security, business resilience and operational excellence. We recognise that sustainable growth in financial services requires more than financial performance; it demands the right people, robust systems, sound processes and the discipline to consistently deliver on stakeholder expectations. “Our focus remains on strengthening the institution, deepening stakeholder confidence and creating sustainable value for our clients and investors.” WealthBridge Asset Management is a subsidiary of WealthBridge Financial Services Holdings Limited. The developments align with the group’s three-year strategic direction, themed “Charting the Next Frontier of Growth”, which focuses on sustainable growth, business transformation, innovation, technology, operational efficiency, customer acquisition and retention, and enhanced value creation across the group.
